description: Уникальные сессии через groupby и unstack
code:
import pandas as pd
f = pd.read_csv("app_funnel.csv", parse_dates=["ts"])
steps = ["открыл", "меню", "корзина", "оплата", "заказ"]
f["period"] = (f["ts"] >= "2026-06-15").map({True: "после 15.06", False: "до 15.06"})
pv = f.groupby(["platform", "period", "step"]).session_id.nunique().unstack()[steps]
conv = pv["заказ"] / pv["оплата"]
pay_conv = (conv * 100).round(1)
before, after = conv[("android", "до 15.06")], conv[("android", "после 15.06")]
lost = round(pv.loc[("android", "после 15.06"), "оплата"] * (before - after))
print(pay_conv)
print(lost)

description: Таблица приписывает конверсии Android платформе iOS и наоборот

import pandas as pd
f = pd.read_csv("app_funnel.csv", parse_dates=["ts"])
steps = ["открыл", "меню", "корзина", "оплата", "заказ"]
f["period"] = (f["ts"] >= "2026-06-15").map({True: "после 15.06", False: "до 15.06"})
pv = f.groupby(["platform", "period", "step"]).session_id.nunique().unstack()[steps]
conv = pv["заказ"] / pv["оплата"]
pay_conv = (conv * 100).round(1)
before, after = conv[("android", "до 15.06")], conv[("android", "после 15.06")]
lost = round(pv.loc[("android", "после 15.06"), "оплата"] * (before - after))
print(pay_conv)
print(lost)
pay_conv = pay_conv.rename(index={"android": "ios", "ios": "android"}, level=0)
print(pay_conv)
